## Definitions

- [statement] Duplo lists an external waste bin for the DC-746; this is a manufacturer feature claim. (low confidence) — https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-746-slitter-cutter-creaser/

## Structure and components

- [statement] Lassco states that the CR-50 accepts Standard, Special and Large cutting units and includes one Standard unit. Tool selection is part of configuring the corner-rounding operation. (low confidence) — https://www.lasscowizer.com/cr-50-manual-corner-cutter/

## How it works

- [statement] The AeroCut X manual warns that overfilled waste can cause errors or breakdown. Waste removal therefore belongs in the cutting workflow. (low confidence) — https://mbmcorp.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/AeroCut-X-OPERATION-MANUALinch.pdf
- [statement] Duplo describes the DC-746 cutting mechanism as rotary slitters plus a guillotine cutter. (low confidence) — https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-746-slitter-cutter-creaser/

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] MBM’s AeroCut X product page rates speed at 24 sheets/minute for two cuts and one crease on an 8 1/2 × 11 sheet. That rating does not measure completed rounded playing-card decks. (low confidence) — https://mbmcorp.com/product/aerocut-x-digital-print-finisher/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The CR-50 manual rates Standard/Special cutting units for paper stacks up to 1/2 inch and Large cutting units for stacks up to 1/8 inch. The applicable stack limit depends on the installed cutting-unit class. (low confidence) — https://www.lasscowizer.com/cmsb/uploads/cr50-manual-small.pdf
- [statement] Print & Finishing Solutions identifies a nicked blade as a possible cause of ragged slit edges. Treat this as dealer troubleshooting guidance, not a measured failure rate. (low confidence) — https://www.pfsgraphics.com/resources-slitter-cutters-trimmers
- [statement] In an April 2024 PrintPlanet thread, operator COGordon reported Duplo 646 double-feeding on stocks lighter than card stock despite service-company settings. This is an anecdote about that machine, not a failure-rate measurement or evidence against the DC-746. (low confidence) — https://printplanet.com/threads/methods-for-reducing-static-on-duplo-646.294079/ · keywords: Sheet cutting slitting and corner rounding · also: https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-746-slitter-cutter-creaser/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] PrintNinja describes a stack smoothing/rounding operation after trimming, while its domestic rotary-die route forms final size and rounded corners together. These are alternative production routes, rather than a requirement that every card use both. (low confidence) — https://printninja.com/card-game-production/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The Game Crafter documents die cutting with rounded corners except on its trading-card format, establishing a card-production route that does not require separately rounding rectangular cuts. (low confidence) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/85-cards
- [statement] Duplo lists the DC-746 feeder at 150 mm, stock weight at 110–350 gsm, and maxima of 10 slits and 30 cuts per sheet. These are manufacturer specifications for this model, not measured playing-card production results. (low confidence) — https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-746-slitter-cutter-creaser/
- [statement] In the AeroCut X manual’s MANUSET layout table, gutter H starts at 0.08 inch depending on paper; entering zero requests single cuts. Layout planning must distinguish a removed gutter from a shared cut. (low confidence) — https://mbmcorp.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/AeroCut-X-OPERATION-MANUALinch.pdf
- [statement] Print & Finishing Solutions warns that heavily static-charged paper can produce misfeeds, double feeds or jams. This dealer’s troubleshooting guidance qualifies expectations of uninterrupted automatic slitting/cutting. (low confidence) — https://www.pfsgraphics.com/resources-slitter-cutters-trimmers
- [statement] In a December 2021 PrintPlanet discussion about a Duplo 618 cutting crooked, one participant reported similar problems with dirty rollers and said cleaning resolved them. This is an operator anecdote about that model, not a general reliability estimate. (low confidence) — https://printplanet.com/threads/duplo-618-slitter-cutter-creaser-problems.291812/
- [statement] Rollem describes the SlipStream III cutting route as first-direction slitting, with or without bleed, followed by right-angle transfer into the second-direction cutter. This is manufacturer evidence for a two-direction sheet-to-card cutting architecture. (low confidence) — https://rollem.com/news/monthly-new-feature-slipstream-cutting-module/
- [statement] Duplo lists automated job setup and changeovers for the DC-746. (low confidence) — https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-746-slitter-cutter-creaser/
- [statement] MBM lists a four-inch sheet capacity and a nominal paper-weight range of 120–400 gsm for the AeroCut X. These are manufacturer ratings. (low confidence) — https://mbmcorp.com/product/aerocut-x-digital-print-finisher/
- [statement] Lassco Wizer lists the CR-55 as a manual foot-operated corner cutter with a two-inch cutting capacity. (low confidence) — https://www.lasscowizer.com/cr-55/
- [statement] Lassco Wizer lists CR-55 blade radii of one-eighth, one-quarter, three-eighths and one-half inch. (low confidence) — https://www.lasscowizer.com/cr-55/
- [statement] The CR-55 manual warns that the bottom card can slide forward and calls for testing on scrap; rated lift capacity alone does not demonstrate a successful card batch. (low confidence) — https://www.lasscowizer.com/cmsb/uploads/cr-55-manual.pdf
- [statement] The CR-55 manual says its blades can dull and can be sharpened. (low confidence) — https://www.lasscowizer.com/cmsb/uploads/cr-55-manual.pdf
- [statement] MBM’s AeroCut X product page displays $43,887 for its slitter, cutter, creaser and perforator. This is a displayed finishing-equipment price; a configured printer-to-boxed-game production-line quote would need separate confirmation of currency, tax, freight and installed-cost inclusions. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://mbmcorp.com/product/aerocut-x-digital-print-finisher/
